paper_statement: There exists a finite hypothesis class that is not properly generatable in the limit with replay.
quantifiers: There exists the stated four-member class; for every proper generator, an adaptive legal enumeration with replay defeats it.
acceptance: Represent the two integer half-lines exactly, not by a bounded window.
Exhaust all four possible first proper outputs.
For each branch prove replay legality and exact enumeration for two simultaneous targets.
Prove no member of H is a subset of the exact target intersection.
An independent checker must accept, while a mutated class with an admissible output must be rejected.
